name-01.output: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?
name-01.direct: Lin Xiao, why did you come so early today?
name-01.reflect: 直译准确自然，'来得这么早'在英文中常用'come in so early'或'come so early'，语气是日常询问，无需调整。
name-01.free: Lin Xiao, how come you're here so early today?

context-01.output: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.
context-01.direct: Don't worry, I've already memorized it thoroughly.
context-01.reflect: 直译准确自然。'背熟了'指把内容背得很熟练，英文用 memorize thoroughly 或 have it down pat 都地道。上下文无特定指代，保持通用即可。
context-01.free: Don't worry, I've got it memorized.

slang-01.output: That move was way too slick—I'm literally losing it.
slang-01.direct: This wave of operation is too showy, I directly split open.
slang-01.reflect: 直译完全不通：'这波操作'是网络用语，指'这一系列举动/这波操作'；'秀'是'厉害/骚'的意思；'裂开'是网络梗，表示震惊到崩溃。需要用地道英文网络表达。
slang-01.free: That move was way too slick—I'm literally losing it.

idiom-01.direct: This of yours is simply drawing legs on a snake.
idiom-01.reflect: 直译保留了成语字面，但英文读者不懂这个典故，会误解。英语里有对应习语 gild the lily，表示多此一举、画蛇添足，更地道。

short-01.reflect: 单字应答，语气平淡，英文用 Yeah 或 Mm 都自然，Yeah 更通用。

corpus-01.output: I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.
corpus-01.direct: Teacher, I really did write my homework, but it was eaten by the dog.
corpus-01.reflect: 直译准确，但英文里"the dog ate my homework"是学生找借口的经典梗，用过去时更自然，且"Teacher"在英语课堂称呼中不地道，通常直接说"I really did my homework"或加"Mr./Ms."，但此处无姓名，省略称呼更自然。
corpus-01.free: I really did my homework, but the dog ate it.

corpus-02.output: That head tilt was just him sneaking a peek at the lines!
corpus-02.direct: That tilt of the head was stealing a look at the words!
corpus-02.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"偷看词"在英文里更自然的说法是 sneak a peek at the lines/words；"偏头那一下"指刚才那个歪头的动作，用 that head tilt 更口语。
corpus-02.free: That head tilt was just him sneaking a peek at the lines!

corpus-03.output: Nah, not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.
corpus-03.direct: Not dating, keeping a sense of mystery is pretty good.
corpus-03.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not dating / not getting into a relationship). "保持神秘感挺好的" means keeping an air of mystery is nice. The tone is casual and a bit playful/defensive. Direct translation is accurate; just needs to sound natural and colloquial in English.
corpus-03.free: Nah, not dating. Keeping a little mystery is nice.

corpus-04.reflect: 直译生硬，不符合英语口语习惯。原文表达对某事来得突然的惊讶，英语母语者常说 That was so sudden 或 This is so sudden。

corpus-05.output: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Like, who even gets this question?
corpus-05.direct: It's just hahaha too abstract, who understands this question
corpus-05.reflect: “太抽象了”是网络流行语，指事情离谱、让人摸不着头脑，直译 abstract 英文观众也能懂但略生硬；“谁懂啊”是网络口头禅，表示共鸣/吐槽，不是真的问谁懂，应译成口语化的吐槽语气。
corpus-05.free: It's just—hahaha, that's so random. Like, who even gets this question?

corpus-06.output: I think it's true—I even came across leaked videos from his concert.
corpus-06.direct: It seems to be true, I even scrolled to his concert's leaked videos.
corpus-06.reflect: "刷到" is internet slang for coming across something while scrolling; "路透" means leaked/spoiler footage. "好像是真的" expresses tentative belief. Natural English would say "I think it's true" or "Seems real."
corpus-06.free: I think it's true—I even came across leaked videos from his concert.

corpus-07.output: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?
corpus-07.direct: Which class meeting, how come I didn't hear it?
corpus-07.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"班会"指班级会议，"我怎么没听着"是口语化的反问，表达惊讶/疑惑自己没被告知。英文里用"How come I didn't hear about it?"更自然，"class meeting"可保留。
corpus-07.free: Which class meeting? How come I didn't hear about it?

corpus-08.output: Besides, he's got that honest, down-to-earth vibe that makes him so approachable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.
corpus-08.direct: Besides, his honest and simple aura is so approachable. You don't lose out this time—maybe you can even mooch a meal with this face.
corpus-08.reflect: “憨厚老实的气质”指人看起来老实可靠、接地气；“亲民”是让人觉得亲切、没有距离感；“你这波不亏”是网络口语，意思是这波操作/选择不吃亏；“蹭顿饭”是白吃一顿、蹭饭。直译基本准确，但“mooch a meal with this face”稍显生硬，可调整为更自然的表达。
corpus-08.free: Besides, he's got that honest, down-to-earth vibe that makes him so approachable. You're not losing out here—you might even score a free meal with that face.

corpus-09.output: Should we throw this souvenir away?
corpus-09.direct: Should this souvenir be thrown away?
corpus-09.reflect: 直译准确自然，'要不要'表达征求意见的语气，英文用'Should...'恰当，无需改动。
corpus-09.free: Should we throw this souvenir away?

corpus-10.output: That idea of yours is pretty out there.
corpus-10.direct: Your idea is also abstract enough.
corpus-10.reflect: 直译生硬，'抽象'是网络用语，指想法离谱、奇葩，英文应表达'想法很离谱/奇怪'，语气带调侃。
corpus-10.free: That idea of yours is pretty out there.

corpus-11.output: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap when I get back to China.
corpus-11.direct: Alright, wait until I return to the country to deal with these poisonous chicken soups.
corpus-11.reflect: "毒鸡汤" is internet slang for toxic motivational platitudes, not literal soup; "回国处理" means handle/deal with them after going back to China. Need to render the slang naturally.
corpus-11.free: Fine, I'll deal with all this toxic motivational crap when I get back to China.

corpus-12.output: That short? Hit a creative block or something?
corpus-12.direct: So short, did you hit a creative bottleneck?
corpus-12.reflect: 直译准确传达了字面意思和调侃语气。'创作瓶颈'英文常用 creative block 或 writer's block，'这么短'指内容篇幅短，用 That short 更口语自然。
corpus-12.free: That short? Hit a creative block or something?

corpus-14.output: Your proposal vs. your colleague's slides — who comes out on top?
corpus-14.direct: Your proposal vs. your colleague's PPT — who is more superior?
corpus-14.reflect: "谁更胜一筹" is a set phrase meaning "who comes out on top / who has the edge"; "vs" is fine as a playful comparison. "More superior" is ungrammatical, and "PPT" in Chinese office slang means the slide deck/presentation, so "PPT" works but "slides" reads more naturally.
corpus-14.free: Your proposal vs. your colleague's slides — who comes out on top?

corpus-15.output: Just look at that fake-deep expression—you can tell something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.
corpus-15.direct: Looking at that deliberately profound expression of his, you know there's a cat in it—this kind of deadpan nonsense has the best comedic effect.
corpus-15.reflect: "有猫腻" is an idiom meaning something fishy is going on, not literally a cat; "故作高深" means putting on a mysteriously profound air; "一本正经的胡说八道" is a well-known phrase for deadpan/straight-faced nonsense. Need to render these idiomatically and keep the casual, amused tone.
corpus-15.free: Just look at that fake-deep expression—you can tell something's fishy. That kind of straight-faced nonsense is comedy gold.

corpus-16.output: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you're always posting sunrises on your Moments.
corpus-16.direct: Why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrises on your Moments every day.
corpus-16.reflect: "我去" is an exclamation of surprise/realization, not "I go"; "不早说" means "why didn't you say earlier"; "朋友圈" is WeChat Moments, commonly rendered as "Moments" or "feed". Tone is playful realization/teasing.
corpus-16.free: Damn, why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you're always posting sunrises on your Moments.

corpus-17.output: Nah, I'm not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.
corpus-17.direct: No deal, these days love is all clearly priced.
corpus-17.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not going to date/be in a relationship), not "no deal." "明码标价" means openly priced/tagged with a price—here it means love has become transactional, everything has a price tag. Need colloquial tone.
corpus-17.free: Nah, I'm not dating. These days love comes with a price tag.

corpus-18.direct: No dating, go play by yourself.
corpus-18.reflect: "不处" is slang for "不处对象" (not going to date/be in a relationship), and "自己玩去" is a dismissive "go play by yourself / go away." Direct translation misses the romantic-rejection nuance and sounds stiff.

corpus-19.output: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.direct: Look at the lottery ticket I bought, the winning numbers are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.
corpus-19.reflect: 直译准确传达了字面意思，但'你看'在口语中更像是引起注意的感叹，英文用'Look'稍显生硬，可调整为更自然的表达；'中奖号码'指彩票上的中奖号码，翻译正确。整体语气是惊讶/兴奋，需要保留。
corpus-19.free: Look, the winning numbers on the lottery ticket I bought are exactly the same as what you said yesterday.

corpus-20.output: Hakimi, north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.
corpus-20.direct: Hakimi north-south green beans, I'm holding it in at my workstation until I get internal injuries.
corpus-20.reflect: "哈基米" is a viral pet meme (a cat/dog sound from Douyin), and "南北绿豆" is a nonsense meme phrase paired with it; together they're playful internet filler. "憋出内伤" means suppressing laughter so hard it hurts inside. Literal translation would confuse English viewers, so I should convey the meme-y tone and the suppressed-laughter meaning naturally.
corpus-20.free: Hakimi, north-south mung beans—I'm dying trying not to laugh at my desk.

corpus-21.output: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.
corpus-21.direct: On the subway I ran into a big bro who kept talking to himself using anime lines the whole time.
corpus-21.reflect: “大哥”是口语中对陌生男子的称呼，不是字面“big brother”，英文用 guy 更自然；“全程”表示整个乘车过程；“动漫台词”即 anime lines。整体语气是吐槽/分享趣事，保持口语化。
corpus-21.free: Ran into this guy on the subway who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-22.output: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed till my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.direct: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed until my stomach hurt.
corpus-22.reflect: 直译准确自然，'laughed until my stomach hurt' 是英语中表达笑到肚子疼的地道说法，'stayed up late' 对应熬夜，语气轻松口语化，无需改动。
corpus-22.free: Last night I stayed up late watching your livestream and laughed till my stomach hurt.

corpus-23.output: Was in such a hurry to leave that I grabbed the rag and took it to work, thinking it was my towel.
corpus-23.direct: In a hurry to go out, I directly took the rag to the company as a towel.
corpus-23.reflect: 直译准确但生硬；'直接把抹布当毛巾带公司去了'是口语化自嘲，英文应更自然，用 'grabbed' 和 'thinking it was' 体现匆忙中拿错的意味。
corpus-23.free: Was in such a hurry to leave that I grabbed the rag and took it to work, thinking it was my towel.

corpus-24.output: Not looking for a relationship. This drama's too juicy for me to handle.
corpus-24.direct: Not dating. The melon is too big to bite through.
corpus-24.reflect: "不处"是网络用语，指不谈恋爱/不处对象；"瓜"是网络梗，指八卦/大新闻；"啃不动"指消化不了。直译会让人误解为真的在吃瓜。需要意译出"不谈恋爱，这八卦太劲爆我消化不了"的意思。
corpus-24.free: Not looking for a relationship. This drama's too juicy for me to handle.

corpus-27.output: Isn't that how it should be?
corpus-27.direct: Isn't this what should be done?
corpus-27.reflect: 直译准确，但英文口语中更自然的反问表达是 Isn't that how it should be? 或 Isn't that the way it should be?，语气上带有理所当然的反问。
corpus-27.free: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-28.output: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.direct: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.
corpus-28.reflect: 直译准确自然，'保洁阿姨'译为 cleaning lady 符合英语口语习惯，'要和...结婚了'用 is going to marry 传达即将结婚的意思，语气平实，无需调整。
corpus-28.free: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-29.output: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better suited for heavier people trying to lose fat?
corpus-29.direct: Treadmill, elliptical, and spin bike, which one is more suitable for high-body-weight fat-loss people?
corpus-29.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'大体重减脂人群'直译生硬，英文更常说'people with a high body weight who want to lose fat'或'heavier people trying to lose fat'；'动感单车'指spin bike，'更适合'用better suited更自然。
corpus-29.free: Treadmill, elliptical, or spin bike—which is better suited for heavier people trying to lose fat?

corpus-31.output: Oh man, I can't even—I'll be laughing about this for a year. Come on, we've all got some embarrassing story about buying pads!
corpus-31.direct: Oh my, I can't take it anymore, this kind of experience I can laugh about for a year, who among us doesn't have some social-death story about buying sanitary pads!
corpus-31.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'social-death'是中式网络梗，英文观众不易理解，应改为embarrassing/awkward；'I can't take it anymore'在此是笑到受不了，用I can't even更口语化；'who among us doesn't have'稍显生硬，可改为we've all got。
corpus-31.free: Oh man, I can't even—I'll be laughing about this for a year. Come on, we've all got some embarrassing story about buying pads!

corpus-32.output: I'm already running a fever—please, ladies, cut me some slack.
corpus-32.direct: I'm already running a fever, please let me go, aunties.
corpus-32.reflect: "大妈们" refers to nosy middle-aged women (often gossiping or nagging); "放过我吧" means "spare me / cut me some slack." Literal "let me go" sounds like being physically held. Need a natural, exasperated tone.
corpus-32.free: I'm already running a fever—please, ladies, cut me some slack.

corpus-33.output: Watch Gen Z chat in textspeak
corpus-33.direct: Watch post-00s chat in Martian language
corpus-33.reflect: "火星文" is Chinese internet slang for the stylized, hard-to-read text/leet-speak that young people use online, not literal Martian. "00后" means the post-2000s generation. Need a natural English equivalent like "watch Gen Z chat in internet slang" or "textspeak."
corpus-33.free: Watch Gen Z chat in textspeak

corpus-34.output: I'm constantly getting interrupted by messages at work and can't stay focused. Any tips for improving efficiency?
corpus-34.direct: At work, I'm always interrupted by all kinds of messages, making it hard to focus on doing things. What methods are there to improve efficiency?
corpus-34.reflect: 直译准确，但英文表达略显生硬。'各种消息'可译为 'constant messages' 更自然，'难以专注做事'用 'hard to stay focused' 更地道，'有什么提高效率的方法'用 'any tips for improving efficiency' 更符合口语提问习惯。
corpus-34.free: I'm constantly getting interrupted by messages at work and can't stay focused. Any tips for improving efficiency?

corpus-38.output: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi from a Shandong lady's stall, and it got me wondering—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the country?
corpus-38.direct: Scrolling videos, I saw the super huge jianbing guozi made by a Shandong auntie's stall, and suddenly I got curious: is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the whole country?
corpus-38.reflect: 直译基本准确，但'auntie's stall'稍显生硬，'auntie'在英文语境中不如'woman'自然；'jianbing guozi'作为文化词保留拼音合理；'got curious'口语自然。整体语气是随意的网络分享，需保持轻松感。
corpus-38.free: I was scrolling through videos and saw this huge jianbing guozi from a Shandong lady's stall, and it got me wondering—is Shandong jianbing the biggest in the country?

corpus-39.output: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.
corpus-39.direct: Douban's high score of 9.4 also proves its quality.
corpus-39.reflect: 直译准确自然，'豆瓣9.4的高分'在英文语境中可保留 Douban 并说明是评分，'也证明了它的品质'直译即可，语气平实客观，无需改动。
corpus-39.free: Its 9.4 rating on Douban also proves its quality.

corpus-40.output: I can't handle this—good things came way too suddenly!
corpus-40.direct: I can't take it anymore, happiness came too suddenly.
corpus-40.reflect: 直译准确，但"I can't take it anymore"在英文里常带负面/受不了的意味，这里其实是激动到招架不住，语气需调整；"幸福来得太突然"是网络流行语，表示好事突然降临让人惊喜到不知所措，英文可用口语化的表达。
corpus-40.free: I can't handle this—good things came way too suddenly!

corpus-41.output: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.
corpus-41.direct: Others: white-browed tiger with upward-slanting eyes. Me: Qiaolezi ice cream.
corpus-41.reflect: This is a meme contrasting a fierce, intimidating image (the classic tiger from Water Margin) with a harmless, silly one (a Qiaolezi ice cream bar). '吊睛白额虎' is a set phrase for a fierce tiger; '巧乐兹' is a Chinese ice cream brand. The joke is the contrast between 'others' being fierce/cool and 'me' being soft/silly. Keeping the brand name transliterated preserves the meme feel.
corpus-41.free: Others: a fierce white-browed tiger. Me: a Qiaolezi ice cream bar.

corpus-42.output: Hahaha I can't even, people online this time are seriously too funny
corpus-42.direct: Hahaha I can't anymore, this batch of netizens is really too talented.
corpus-42.reflect: "我不行了" here means laughing too hard to handle it, not literally being unable to continue; "这届网友" is internet slang meaning "this generation of netizens/people online," and "太有才了" is admiring their wit. Direct version is understandable but "this batch" sounds odd and "too talented" is a bit stiff.
corpus-42.free: Hahaha I can't even, people online this time are seriously too funny

corpus-44.output: I'm done. I've been working so much overtime I'm completely numb.
corpus-44.direct: I can't anymore, working overtime until I'm numb.
corpus-44.reflect: “我不行了”是口语化的崩溃感叹，“人都麻了”是网络流行语，表示累到麻木、没感觉了，直译“numb”能传达这层意思，但“I can't anymore”稍显生硬，英文母语者更常说“I'm done”或“I can't take it anymore”。
corpus-44.free: I'm done. I've been working so much overtime I'm completely numb.

corpus-45.output: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called that... Xiao Chao Team, right? I remember it all!
corpus-45.direct: I watch every one of your videos. Your team is called that whatever Xiao Chao Team, right? I remember it all!
corpus-45.reflect: 直译基本准确，但"那个啥"是口语化的犹豫/模糊表达，英文用"that... whatever it's called"更自然；"小潮team"是团队名，保留拼音Xiao Chao Team；"我都记得的"语气是热情确认，用"I remember it all"可以，但更口语化可说"I've got it all memorized"。
corpus-45.free: I watch every single one of your videos. Your team's called that... Xiao Chao Team, right? I remember it all!

corpus-47.output: Can you stop dragging me into playing games with you?
corpus-47.direct: Can you stop pulling me to play games?
corpus-47.reflect: "拉着我打游戏" means dragging/pulling someone into playing games with you; "pulling me" is a bit literal but understandable. More natural English: "dragging me into playing games" or "making me play games with you." The tone is mild complaint/annoyance.
corpus-47.free: Can you stop dragging me into playing games with you?

corpus-48.output: I can't take it, this is way too cute!
corpus-48.direct: I can't take it anymore, this is way too cute!
corpus-48.reflect: 直译准确传达了'我不行了'的夸张感叹和'太可爱了'的程度，'I can't take it'在英语里正是看到可爱事物时夸张表达受不了的地道说法，语气自然。
corpus-48.free: I can't take it, this is way too cute!

corpus-49.output: I can't take it anymore—I know everything, I've grinded myself bald.
corpus-49.direct: I can't anymore, I know it all, grinding until bald.
corpus-49.reflect: "我不行了" expresses exhaustion/overwhelm, "肝到秃头" is internet slang for grinding so hard you go bald (from overwork/gaming). Need natural English conveying the self-deprecating humor about overwork.
corpus-49.free: I can't take it anymore—I know everything, I've grinded myself bald.
